business_problem: Fengtu Technology needed to run GPU-heavy inspection and safety models in the cloud without wasting compute, while also improving fatigue detection and commercial-vehicle risk response for logistics customers.
solution_summary: Fengtu Technology used Huawei Cloud FunctionGraph to build a serverless inference platform for transport safety and vehicle-quality inspection workloads. The platform turns model execution into event-driven functions that automatically scale GPU-backed instances with request concurrency, so the team can run inference and device self-check logic without managing fixed clusters. For commercial-vehicle safety, Fengtu combines driving-assistance hardware, a transport supervision platform, 24/7 operations support, and a cloud safety platform for risk prediction, real-time intervention, investigation reporting, and alarm workflows. Its DMS fatigue-detection pipeline uses cloud compensation and alert cleaning to detect fatigue, distraction, smoking, phone use, and camera occlusion, while a lightweight ResNet classifier checks camera status. Image-heavy self-test steps run inside FunctionGraph using fractional GPU allocation and built-in monitoring logs.

business_outcome: Fengtu improved fatigue-risk detection, cut invalid alerts and operating cost, and turned GPU-heavy inference into an elastic cloud service with higher business reliability.
metrics: more than 40% reduction in invalid alerts
around 10% reduction in escort labor input
architecture_clues: Inference is event-driven and scaled automatically according to concurrency.
GPU resources are allocated at a minimum granularity of 1/16.
Device self-check steps offload image computation to FunctionGraph.
Built-in monitoring logs are used to observe model and service execution.

data_flow: Images and driving-event inputs are routed into FunctionGraph, where GPU-backed functions run inference and self-check steps on demand. Detection outputs flow into the safety cloud platform, which cleans alerts, triggers alarms, supports investigations, and feeds risk-intervention workflows for commercial-vehicle operators.
